footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Diversified Energy: includes a $40.5M income tax benefit; after $784K attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.4× to $1.8B in 2025. Operating income was $535M, up from a $97.1M loss.

Net income was $341M, or $4.58 per share, after a $104M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $465M and free cash flow $280M, versus $169M; Diversified Energy returned $85.0M through dividends.
watch: Net income includes a $40.5M tax benefit.
sources: Diversified Energy Company Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
